overrides.tagline: Oversized tees with a pastel gradient look, prototyped in Figma
overrides.summary: A modern T-shirt design for Namwear's Oversized collection, crafted in Figma with a pastel gradient aesthetic and an interactive prototype.
description: Namwear's Oversized collection needed a recognisable look across its tees and how they're presented.
The designs pair bold, oversized type with a pastel gradient palette, and the collection is presented as an interactive Figma prototype.

features.title: Pastel gradient aesthetic
features.desc: A soft gradient palette carried across the collection.

features.title: Oversized type
features.desc: Bold OVERSIZED lettering as the collection's signature.

features.title: Interactive prototype
features.desc: A clickable Figma prototype presenting the collection.

challenge: A streetwear collection needs a consistent look across products and presentation. Namwear's was designed and prototyped in Figma.

screens.caption: The Oversized collection in the Figma prototype.
